  <div class="rtext rtext--box-none txt--light" id="rtext__1667904931682">
    <div class="rtext__content clear normal-text">
      <h3>We have two objectives in this demo:</h3>
<ol>
<li>Create a playlist.</li>
<li>Preload (cache) upcoming content.</li>
</ol>
<p>The playlist is created through a combination of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and the <a href="https://docs.portal.theoplayer.com/docs/api-reference/theoplayer"><span style="color: #ffc713;">THEOplayer API</span></a><span>. The following events from the API are used:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>ended: thrown when the current stream ends.</span></li>
<li><span>playing: thrown when the playback of media starts.</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>The preloading mechanism is built with the Caching API and the Player API:</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span>timeupdate: thrown periodically when currentTime changes. We use this event to compute how much of the current video has already been played. If this exceeds 75%, we cache the upcoming playlist item.</span></li>
<li><span><a href="https://docs.portal.theoplayer.com/docs/next/api-reference/theoplayer-cachingtask/"><span style="color: #ffc713;">CachingTask</span></a>: a CachingTask can be started to preload content.</span></li>
</ul>
